description: Validation module that checks all built enrichment modules conform to the enrichment contract: (1) each has compute_score(metadata: dict) returning (float, dict), (2) evidence blob contains signal_type field, (3) each reads at least 5 distinct metadata fields, (4) each produces at least 20 distinct scores across synthetic corpus. Should query information_schema.columns and test each module with synthetic inputs. Output a validation report listing compliant and non-compliant enrichments. Do NOT write to DB - read-only validation.
